panels.description: Overview of currently active on-demand computational clusters (clusters-keeper primary/manager machines) and their associated worker EC2 machines

targets.expr: count(count by(user_id, wallet_id) ((simcore_service_clusters_keeper_primary_connected_instances{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id"} > 0) or (simcore_service_clusters_keeper_primary_starting_instances{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id"} > 0))) or vector(0)

(sum(simcore_service_clusters_keeper_primary_starting_instances{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"}) + sum(simcore_service_clusters_keeper_primary_connected_instances{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"}) + sum(simcore_service_clusters_keeper_primary_broken_instances{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Computational clusters at a glance

panels.description: One row per active cluster (a cluster = one user + one wallet: each wallet a user works with gets its own dedicated primary + worker pool, so the same user can legitimately have several rows). Click a row to filter the 'User ID'/'Wallet ID' variables and see the full breakdown in 'All clusters details' below.

targets.expr: sum by (user_id, wallet_id) ((simcore_service_clusters_keeper_primary_starting_instances{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"} > 0) or (simcore_service_clusters_keeper_primary_connected_instances{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"} > 0) or (simcore_service_clusters_keeper_primary_broken_instances{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"} > 0))

sum by (user_id, wallet_id) ((simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_active_nodes{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"} > 0) or (simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_pending_nodes{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"} > 0) or (simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_drained_nodes{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"} > 0) or (simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_hot_buffer_drained_nodes{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"} > 0) or (simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_pending_ec2s{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"} > 0) or (simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_broken_ec2s{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"} > 0) or (simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_warm_buffer_ec2s{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"} > 0))

panels.title: Clusters at a glance (per user + wallet)

sum by(instance_type, user_id, wallet_id) (simcore_service_clusters_keeper_primary_connected_instances{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"}) - sum by(instance_type, user_id, wallet_id) (simcore_service_clusters_keeper_primary_busy_instances{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"})

sum by(instance_type, user_id, wallet_id) (simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_active_nodes{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"})
sum by(instance_type, user_id, wallet_id) (simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_pending_nodes{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"})
sum by(instance_type, user_id, wallet_id) (simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_drained_nodes{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"})

sum by(instance_type, user_id, wallet_id) (simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_warm_buffer_ec2s{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"})

(sum(simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_pending_ec2s{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"}) + sum(simcore_service_autoscaling_computational_cluster_pending_nodes{user_id=~"$user_id", wallet_id=~"$wallet_id", instance_type=~"$ec2_type"})) or vector(0)
